messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed chat endpoints are tripping burst throttles more often than embeddings; customers see 429s on short interactive sessions. Anyone else?
sam: saw that too. telemetry shows spikes aligned with UI reconnects. :frowning:
aditya: Is this per-key or per-org? Could be shared bucket saturation from background embedding jobs.
maya: It's per-key config. But our enforcement treats streaming/chat as token-based bursts (token buckets) and embeddings as request-based. So mismatch.
li: That's intentional historically, but agree mismatch causes surprising UX. Propose unify into "endpoint-aware" buckets with token vs request semantics.
sam: What about smoothing window? currently burst window is 1s. Maybe 3s for chat to absorb reconnect jitter.
ops-bot: incident-alert: throttle-rate > 1000 events in last 5m for key=abcde on prod-east.
aditya: We need console visibility — per-route recent-burst metric on token/sec and requests/sec. Also show waveform and top callers.
maya: UX: expose "burst smoothing" toggle per endpoint + preview cost impact. Small text: "may increase tail latency slightly".
li: Edge-case: streaming uses long-lived connection; our current leaky-bucket resets on connection close -> can be gamed. Need per-connection token accounting.
sam: Implementation idea: assign per-connection bucket backed by shared org bucket. When conn opens, allow allocated tokens=min(conn_quota, shared_burst_remain). On close, return unused.
maya: here's a sample policy yaml we could use:
```yaml
quotas:
  default:
    mode: endpoint-aware
    endpoints:
      chat:
        unit: tokens
        burst: 1000
        rate: 200/s
        smoothing_window: 3s
      embeddings:
        unit: requests
        burst: 60
        rate: 10/s
      streaming:
        unit: connections
        burst: 50
        rate: 5/s
```
aditya: love it. Also need to wire to rollouts: config flag "enforce_endpoint_buckets" and gradual rollout on Dedicated first.
li: Also add fallback policy: when chat bucket exhausted, route to lighter model variant (gpt-lite) with a "soft-429" header and UI message.
sam: Will telemetry pick up the fallback events? add metric "fallback.count" with tags endpoint/model/reason.
maya: sounds good. Can infra prototype in a branch; I'll create PR to add feature flag + console widgets. Anyone object to 3s smoothing?
aditya: +1
li: +1, but let's A/B it: 50% users for 1 week before full deploy.
sam: I'll update the throttler impl to support per-connection accounting. Plan to ship to staging tomorrow.
maya: thanks. tagging @oncall for visibility. :thumbsup:
oncall: noted, keep me posted. If we see >1% 429s during rollout I'll pause.
